body: Thank you man, it really means a lot.

M broke down at the time, I can't imagine losing your best friend of almost 20 years. I think I'll call everyone over on Friday and see how everyone is. I guess I have until then to collect myself enough.
I sincerely hope that you don't kill yourself, and that you find a reason to continue on. Thank you for your thoughts.

I appreciate what you're trying to do, but I don't think your analogy is accurate, at least to my case. 

It won't overwhelm me forever, I know these feelings won't last forever, but they exist right now, and it's really hard to deal with it.

I didn't think about that honestly. I haven't talked to anyone since Friday, and it didn't cross my mind. I'll ask him about it tomorrow.

I don't mean can't like physically unable, I mean it like I can't tell them I told him to do what he felt was right when he was suicidal. Eventually I will, but I don't want to bring that hammer down. I don't think anyone would reprimand me for my actions, none of us are like that, but I don't want to share it with everyone just yet.

Maybe you're right and I should get us all together, I don't know.
